notes.title: Conduct DELUXE! Patch v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hiya everyone, a few minor fixes and tweaks going out today, focused on Conduct World. This includes minor UI fixes, localization fixes, but most of all, a couple of new achievements to fully acknowledge the arrival of Conduct World! You can earn these new achievements right away!

We're really excited to see the creative uses of Conduct World. A lot of new ideas that we haven't seen before. We are very positive about the future levels to be published, as we are certain that even smarter, wilder, and funnier custom levels will show up!

notes.title: Announcing Conduct World
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31311068/b2bb122754a9cdcbb29127cfab762895e12f0269.jpg[/img]

The Level Builder in Conduct DELUXE! has always been an important part of our vision for the game. However, we always intended the Level Builder to be a very social experience, and with this update we want to enable that social experience for the players, with a new BIG feature for the game. It's called...

[h1]Conduct World![/h1]


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31311068/1798989075b11642f8e9e6270c57905e7c56f708.png[/img]

With a new button from the main menu, you can access Conduct World! From here, you can view levels built by other players from all around the world. Browse, sort, search, and maybe find something that catches your eye? Quick previews of every level lets you peek in at what's in store. Once you find a level that you want to try, a single click later and you're in the action! Your personal progress is tracked across all levels. Any stars earned when playing levels on Conduct World will be displayed in the level browser, so that you can tell which levels you've perfected, and which new ones are waiting for you.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31311068/7827300b144bbd48985963ef4512330394a9dd44.png[/img]

From within the Level Builder, you can publish your own creations to Conduct World. With the press of a button, your proudest creation is now published online for the rest of the world to enjoy! We hope to see players make all kinds of different levels. Easy, hard, short, long, tense, relaxed, contemporary, or avantgarde levels. All is welcome! As a service to the player, all published levels will include information on whether the author themselves are able to complete the level. If you choose to make incredibly hard levels, you can prove to the world that they certainly can be beat! Play and complete your level from within the Level Builder, and it will be marked as completable. If you make any changes to your level, you will have to beat it again to keep its completion status.

We hope to see level creators out there share their creativity and genius on Conduct World! Share your crazy creations with everyone, and don't be afraid to show off the fancy pieces you have unlocked throughout your Conduct journey. If you are a player simply looking for levels to play, there's no need to worry. You can pick and play any level off Conduct World, with no requirements for normal single player unlocks. Go earn yourself some stars on Conduct World!
		
[h1]Major bug fixes and optimizations for the Level Builder[/h1]

We felt that it was important to improve the Level Builder experience, so that the players can focus on building the best levels before they publish them to Conduct World. We have been hard at work and are happy to present an improved Level Builder.

The Level Builder has seen a major rework of the internals, which solves some very annoying bugs. The overall experience of placing tracks, switches, trains, and cars will now be a more smooth and reliable process. Two of the worst problems up to this point have been inconsistent track-to-track snapping, and trains sometimes jumping tracks or starting in the opposite direction when you play the level. Both of these problems are gone with this update. Tracks will connect to eachother as you would expect, and trains will stay on their original tracks and go the expected way.

With this major patch, we also bring improvements to the performance of the Level Builder.  It is very important for us that anyone can play and make custom levels, regardless of how powerful their computer is. We hope that these optimizations will help your Conduct experience be a more pleasent one.

[h1]A note on loading old custom levels[/h1]

Loading a custom level built using an older version of the game (before v1.1) is possible, but any placed trains cars will be missing. This will only happen the first time you load an pre-v1.1 level. You can place any missing trains and cars right away and they will be saved properly from then on. 

Why does this happen?
Because of the big differences in the way the train and car placement information is stored, old custom levels need to be changed to fit the new structure. The game will try to reconstruct the level from the old saved file, but in a way so that it supports the new level structure. This will happen automatically when you load an old custom level, but an unfortunate effect of this transition is that the game can not reliably reconstruct the trains and cars that you have placed previously. We decided that the safest thing to do here is to discard them instead of placing them randomly. We are very sorry for the inconvenience this might cause you. 

[h1]Let's embark on a new adventure![/h1]

We can't wait to see what kind of wacky inventions will appear on Conduct World. We have already included a few of our own creations to get started, but we are really excited to see what the players will build and share with the rest of the world! If you have any suggestions, encounter any bugs, or really want to show us something cool on Conduct World, feel free to send us a message. We are always listening on the Steam Discussions, on our Discord, and on email.

notes.title: Conduct DELUXE! v1.0.7
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Another batch of small fixes incoming:

[list]
    [*]Some trains were not exploding when crashing into things. We believe in equal-kaboom for all trains, no matter make or model. From now on, non-controllable train collisions (such as freight trains) now makes explosions properly and loses the game. This fix covers both normal play and the Level Builder. 
    [*]The camera-shake effect when a crash is happening broke because of a previous patch. The camera now works at 100% capacity again.
    [*]Major performance optimizations when placing certain pieces in the Level Builder. 
[/list]

(More changes and improvements are coming to the Level Builder, stay tuned!)

We would also like to thank everyone who have been sharing their experiences with Conduct DELUXE! on YouTube and Twitch. It makes us very happy to see people all around the world experience the game and all the genuine reactions coming our way is truly heartwarming. ❤️

notes.title: Hey Hey! Conduct DELUXE! v1.0.6!
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Achievements are important, and some of them were broken. Here's a quick fix to solve that!

[list]
    [*]World Unlock Achievements for the Christmas, Space, Western, and Medieval worlds are now awarded when you unlock the respective worlds. These were previously impossible to get.
    [*]As an added security for those who lost who already unlocked these worlds, the game now checks for all eligible achievements on startup, and awards those you should've already gotten. If you are missing some achievements, try starting the game after downloading this patch. If you are missing some train-unlock related achievements, try visiting the HQ instead.
    [*]Fixed an error in how fatalities were counted towards achievement. Previously you would only get two fatalities for crashing a train, no matter how many passengers the train was carrying. The game now counts all passengers correctly. 
[/list]

As a result of the miscount, your current fatality-counts are currently too low compared to the actual amount of passengers lost in crashes. We apoligize for the lower counts up until now.

Thanks to those who reported the missing achievements. If you need any help, catch us on Steam Discussions, on our Discord, or on Email.

If you are missing some achievements, try starting the game after downloading this patch. If you are missing some train-unlock related achievements, try visiting the HQ instead.

[*]Fixed an error in how fatalities were counted towards achievement. Previously you would only get two fatalities for crashing a train, no matter how many passengers the train was carrying. The game now counts all passengers correctly.

notes.title: Conduct DELUXE! v1.0.5 has arrived!
notes.content:
Hi, here's some more fixes for you all to enjoy.

[list]
    [*]Cosmic energies brought into check. The moon levels no longer has trains exploding on start, and trains no longer moves in reverse.
    [*]The level 'Lost at Sea' has had its time limit increased by 5 seconds. We decided that getting a gold time under the previous limit was more frustrating than challenging.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who provided feedback and suggestions. The bugs and changes in this patch was brought to our attention through the Steam Discussions. Your support is wholeheartedly appreciated.

As always, you can contact us on Steam, Discord, or Email. Happy conducting!

notes.title: Conduct DELUXE! v1.0.4 Patch notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone, v1.0.4 is now out.

This patch contains bug fixes and feature requests from the community. Thanks to everyone who pitched in with their ideas or bug reports! ːDː

[list]
[*]OpenGL support for players without DirectX 11.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with the Escape and Space buttons. They now always pause and unpause the game.
[*]Stations placed in the Builder no longer ignores your choice of passenger-colors to spawn.
[*]Fixed text being cut off in the Builder pause menu for certain languages.
[/list]

We would also like to thank everyone again for riding along with us on the Conduct DELUXE! Express. 

Any questions, issues, or feature requests? Please let us know! We keep a close eye on Discord, Steam Community Discussions, and on e-mail.

notes.title: Conduct DELUXE updated to v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, these are the patch notes for v1.0.1

This patch contains a handful of fixes all around. Thanks to everyone who contacted us about bugs and issues.

[list]


[*]Camera now moves at a proper speed, no matter the framerate.
[*]Having a touchscreen available should no longer prevent the mouse from working.
[*]Fixed an issue on macOS 10.11
[*]Added missing localizations for all languages.
[*]Trains/chests from completing the Old West regions should be rewarded properly now.
[*]Crashing Freight Trains now blow up proper, instead of simply falling apart. 
[*]Level Builder: Crashed cars are properly cleaned up when exiting play mode. 
[*]Level Builder: times larger than 200sec should now display properly on the in-game UI.
[*]About Northplay screen was showing incorrect text. Not anymore.
[/list]

If you are still experiencing issues, or have any questions, don't hesitate to contact us. We keep a close eye on Discord, Steam Community Discussions, and on e-mail.

-Crashing Freight Trains now blow up proper, instead of simply falling apart.

notes.title: Conduct DELUXE updated to v1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, these are the patch notes for v1.0.1

This patch contains a handful of fixes all around. Thanks to everyone who contacted us about bugs and issues.

[list]


[*]Camera now moves at a proper speed, no matter the framerate.
[*]Having a touchscreen available should no longer prevent the mouse from working.
[*]Fixed an issue on macOS 10.11
[*]Added missing localizations for all languages.
[*]Trains/chests from completing the Old West regions should be rewarded properly now.
[*]Crashing Freight Trains now blow up proper, instead of simply falling apart. 
[*]Level Builder: Crashed cars are properly cleaned up when exiting play mode. 
[*]Level Builder: times larger than 200sec should now display properly on the in-game UI.
[*]About Northplay screen was showing incorrect text. Not anymore.
[/list]

If you are still experiencing issues, or have any questions, don't hesitate to contact us. We keep a close eye on Discord, Steam Community Discussions, and on e-mail.
